entries.title: Estuary integration test exceeds job limit
entries.root_cause: The estuary integration test waits indefinitely for a batch completion event that the fixture never emits, exhausting the job timeout.

entries.title: Missing archive bucket
entries.root_cause: The archive task requires ESTUARY_ARCHIVE_BUCKET, which is absent from its environment.

entries.title: Invalid dependency pin
entries.root_cause: The requirements file pins a nonexistent version of the packaging distribution.
